Method of Attack: Phishing attacks targeting Chrome extension developers to compromise developer accounts
Insertion of adware code inside extensions and pushing malicious updates overlaying ads on web pages
Attack Vector: Phishing emails posing as Google Chrome Web Store communications
Fake Google login pages hosted on non-Google domains
Freshdesk domains and bit.ly links used in phishing emails
Indicators of Compromise: Fake login pages identical to Google login page
bit.ly links used in subsequent phishing attempts
Hijacking incidents reported on June 21, 2017, July 7, 2017, July 21, 2017, and August 2, 2017
